description: Upcoming football fixtures with fixture ids and a has_prediction flag (1 credit per successful call). Use it to discover matches, then call get_match_prediction with the fixture id or English team names.

league.description: League filter: ESPN key (eng.1) or slug (premier-league). Known aliases such as 英超 work.

team.description: Team name in English, e.g. Arsenal. Chinese names do not resolve.

name: list_fixtures
